+def natural_key(s: str, ignore_case: bool = True):
+    import re
+    parts = re.split(r"(\d+)", s)
+    out = []
+    for p in parts:

+def filter_sort(entries: list[Entry], opts: Opts, is_recurse: bool):

+        entries = [e for e in entries if not any(fnmatch.fnmatchcase(e.name, g) for g in opts.ignore_globs)]

+        entries = [e for e in entries if e.is_dir()]
+    elif opts.only_files and not is_recurse:
+        entries = [e for e in entries if e.is_file() and not e.is_dir()]

+        entries = [e for e in entries if not e.is_link()]

+    if sf == "none":

+                return (type_char(e), natural_key(e.name))

+                return (e.ext().lower() if sf[0].islower() else e.ext(), natural_key(e.name, sf[0].islower()))

+                return (e.mtime(), natural_key(e.name))
+            if sf in {"age", "old", "oldest"}:
+                return (-e.mtime(), natural_key(e.name))

+    if opts.dirs_first:

+    if opts.dirs_last:

+        return "d----" if e.is_dir() else "-a---"
+    st = e.lstat()
+    if not st:
+        return "----------"
+    mode = st.st_mode
+    chars = ["d" if stat.S_ISDIR(mode) else "l" if stat.S_ISLNK(mode) else "-"]
+    for r, w, x in [(stat.S_IRUSR, stat.S_IWUSR, stat.S_IXUSR), (stat.S_IRGRP, stat.S_IWGRP, stat.S_IXGRP), (stat.S_IROTH, stat.S_IWOTH, stat.S_IXOTH)]:
+        chars.extend(["r" if mode & r else "-", "w" if mode & w else "-", "x" if mode & x else "-"])
+    return "".join(chars)
+
+
+def size_text(e: Entry):
+    if e.is_dir():
+        return "-"
+    n = e.size()
+    if n < 1000:
+        return str(n)
+    for unit in ["k", "M", "G", "T"]:
+        n /= 1000.0
+        if n < 1000:
+            return f"{n:.1f}{unit}" if n < 10 else f"{round(n):.0f}{unit}"
+    return f"{n:.0f}P"
+
+
+def time_text(e: Entry):
+    try:
+        dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(e.mtime())
+    except Exception:
+        return "-"
+    return dt.strftime("%d %b %H:%M").lstrip("0")
+
+
+def long_rows(entries: list[Entry], opts: Opts):
+    cols = []
+    if not opts.no_permissions:
+        cols.append(("Mode" if os.name == "nt" else "Permissions", permissions, "left"))
+    if not opts.no_filesize:
+        cols.append(("Size", size_text, "right"))
+    if not opts.no_user and os.name != "nt":
+        cols.append(("User", lambda e: "-", "left"))
+    if not opts.no_time:
+        cols.append(("Date Modified", time_text, "left"))
+    data = [[fn(e) for _, fn, _ in cols] + [display_name(e, opts)] for e in entries]
+    widths = []
+    for idx, (title, _, _) in enumerate(cols):
+        widths.append(max([len(title)] + [len(row[idx]) for row in data] if data else [len(title)]))
+    out = []
+    if opts.header:
+        cells = []
+        for i, (title, _, align) in enumerate(cols):
+            cells.append(title.rjust(widths[i]) if align == "right" else title.ljust(widths[i]))
+        cells.append("Name")
+        out.append(" ".join(cells).rstrip())
+    for row in data:
+        cells = []
+        for i, (_, _, align) in enumerate(cols):
+            cells.append(row[i].rjust(widths[i]) if align == "right" else row[i].ljust(widths[i]))
+        cells.append(row[-1])
+        out.append(" ".join(cells).rstrip())
+    return out
+
+
+def lines_rows(entries: list[Entry], opts: Opts):
+    return [display_name(e, opts) for e in entries]
+
+
+def grid_rows(entries: list[Entry], opts: Opts):
+    names = lines_rows(entries, opts)
+    if not names:
+        return []
+    width = max(1, opts.width)
+    colw = max(len(n) for n in names) + 2
+    cols = max(1, width // colw)
+    rows = (len(names) + cols - 1) // cols
+    out = []
+    for r in range(rows):
+        parts = []
+        for c in range(cols):
+            idx = c * rows + r
+            if idx >= len(names):
+                continue
+            s = names[idx]
+            parts.append(s.ljust(colw) if c < cols - 1 else s)
+        out.append("".join(parts).rstrip())
+    return out
+
+
+def tree_walk(root: Path, opts: Opts, depth=0, prefix_stack=None, root_name=None):
+    prefix_stack = prefix_stack or []
+    rows = []
+    if depth == 0:
+        rows.append(root_name if root_name is not None else str(root))
+    if opts.level is not None and depth >= opts.level:
+        return rows
+    try:
+        entries = read_entries(root, opts)
+    except OSError as e:
+        rows.append(f"<{root}: {e}>")
+        return rows
+    for idx, e in enumerate(entries):
+        last = idx == len(entries) - 1
+        prefix = "".join("    " if p else "│   " for p in prefix_stack)
+        branch = "└── " if last else "├── "
+        rows.append(prefix + branch + display_name(e, opts))

+    return rows
+
+

+    p = Path(path_s)
+    if not p.exists() and not p.is_symlink():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(path_s)
+    if p.is_dir() and not opts.treat_dirs_as_files and not opts.list_dirs:
+        if opts.tree:
+            return tree_walk(p, opts, root_name=path_s)
+        entries = read_entries(p, opts)
+    else:
+        entries = filter_sort([Entry(p, str(PureWindowsPath(path_s)) if os.name == "nt" and ("/" in path_s or "\\" in path_s) else p.name, True)], opts, False)
+    if opts.long:
+        return long_rows(entries, opts)
+    if opts.grid:
+        return grid_rows(entries, opts)
+    return lines_rows(entries, opts)
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
+    try:
+        opts = parse(argv)
+        if opts.stdin:
+            opts.paths = [line.rstrip("\n") for line in sys.stdin if line.rstrip("\n")]
+        all_out = []
+        status = 0
+        multi = len(opts.paths) > 1
+        for idx, p in enumerate(opts.paths):
+            try:
+                if multi:
